# KingDavez Studios

> AI-powered 3D model, texture, and image generation for game devs, indie creators, and Second Life builders.

KingDavez Studios turns text prompts or reference photos into game-ready 3D meshes (GLB, OBJ, STL, FBX), PBR textures, and AI images. Models are exportable for Second Life, Unity, Unreal, Godot, Blender, and 3D printing.

- [Second Life](/second-life): AI mesh, textures, and full-perm builder kits for Second Life. SL Marketplace store and in-world shop on Thranduil.
